Messages.Author: Dr. Enrique Montaño
Messages.Body:
1. A ghouled mortal ally can play potence cards as text says. But can

Yes they can -with life. It's in the Anarch rulebook.

Messages.Author: Timlagor
Messages.Body:
On Wed, 16 Jul 2003 13:38:27 -0400, LSJ wrote:

> Dr. Enrique Montaño wrote:
>> Can they use taste of vitae?
>
> Allies cannot play Taste of Vitae. Card text: "This vampire"

..and they are only playing "as a vampire" for the purposes of the potence
strike which includes resolution of the strike as well as playing it but not
any lingering effects.

They can play Improvised tactics and use the strike every strike of the
combat can't they? It is a strike requiring potence but once it's played it
only refers to "the minon".

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Timlagor wrote:
> [Ghouled allies] can play Improvised tactics and use the strike every strike of the

> combat can't they? It is a strike requiring potence but once it's played it
> only refers to "the minon".

No. Improvised Tactics requires an Anarch.


